guidance.bestFor: File and Edit lists of plain text rows with key hints, dividers and a disabled New Incognito Window

whenNotToUse.when: Links to the pages of a website along its header, opening panels of page summaries
Commands that open a second level list to the side, such as Share or Find

guidance.bestFor: A side flyout in each list, Share with 3 channels under File and Find with 3 search commands under Edit

whenNotToUse.when: A page path whose hidden middle steps open from an ellipsis button
One button opening a list that nests flyouts beside radio and checkbox rows

guidance.bestFor: A View list of 2 browser toggles beside a Theme list whose Light, Dark or System pick is held in state
agentNotes: `theme` only moves the radio tick; hand the Light, Dark or System pick to your theme provider
Neither `MenubarCheckboxItem` is held in state, so Full URLs never unticks and on radix Bookmarks Bar never ticks

whenNotToUse.when: Browser view toggles opened with a right click on the page, with no top bar
Options a user ticks inside a form that is always on screen

guidance.bestFor: A leading icon on every row, with Profile and a destructive Sign out grouped under Account

whenNotToUse.when: A list of plain text rows with key hints and no leading glyph

guidance.bestFor: Bold and Italic rows, Strikethrough and Code toggles and an Insert list with a Media flyout and Link
agentNotes: Strikethrough is pinned on by a bare `checked` and Code is untracked; drive both from the editor's active marks

whenNotToUse.when: Bold, italic and underline buttons always on show above the text, one press each
